electric_power.label: Electric Power Overall Water Risk
electric_power.purpose: Sector proxy sensitivity view; it is not a data-center preset

semiconductor.label: Semiconductor Overall Water Risk
semiconductor.purpose: Sector proxy sensitivity view; it is not a data-center preset

high_or_arid.label: Water-constrained location
conditional: Adaptive hybrid cooling with a binding water budget
Evaporative mode limited to approved climate hours and water availability
excluded: Unconstrained evaporative cooling

medium_high.label: Water-sensitive location
conditional: Closed-loop liquid cooling after hydraulic and redundancy review
Evaporative operation within a verified annual water budget
excluded: Once-through water cooling

low_high_carbon.label: Carbon-intensive grid with lower water constraint
preferred: Cooling efficiency controls and airflow optimisation
conditional: Evaporative cooling after climate-hour and WUE assessment
Liquid cooling where IT density and lifecycle energy savings justify it
excluded: Cooling selections based on PUE alone

low_low_or_moderate_carbon.label: Lower combined water and grid constraint
conditional: Evaporative cooling after local water availability and WUE verification
Liquid cooling aligned with rack-density growth
excluded: Selection without engineering climate and redundancy checks

unknown.label: Insufficient source data
preferred: Obtain decision-grade water and grid-carbon evidence
conditional: Limit activity to reversible efficiency and metering measures
excluded: Irreversible cooling-system selection from incomplete screening data

base_immediate: Validate sub-metered cooling energy and water use
Run an hourly climate and cooling-load engineering study
base_maintenance_window: Inspect controls, containment, airflow and cooling-system setpoints
no_outage_immediate: Prioritise controls, containment and metering changes that preserve redundancy
Pilot changes on redundant capacity with an approved rollback procedure
no_outage_maintenance_window: Schedule intrusive retrofit work within an approved maintenance window
constrained_cost_immediate: Sequence low-disruption efficiency measures before staged capital work
Complete a commercial renewable power purchase agreement assessment
high_growth_expansion: Apply the preferred cooling architecture to planned capacity before retrofitting constrained live halls

disclaimers: This policy supports location screening and does not constitute a final cooling design.
Final design requires engineering checks for temperature, humidity, available power, hydraulics and redundancy.
Electric Power and Semiconductor Aqueduct views are proxy sensitivity views; WRI does not publish a Data Center sector preset.
A renewable power purchase agreement does not change the location-based grid factor or location-based CUE.

default_assumptions.wue_basis: Google 2024 ISO WUE Category 2 fleet proxy for data centers supporting LLM models

methodology_notes: PUE and WUE targets and upper anchors are internal screening values, not industry standards.

Missing site metrics use explicit editable proxies and retain their evidence basis.
